# Palkeoramix decompiler. 

def storage:
  stor0 is uint256 at storage 0
  counter is mapping of uint256 at storage 1
  orderStatus is mapping of struct of 1 slot at storage 2
  contractOffererNonce is mapping of uint256 at storage 3

def SafeMath:
  def add(a, b):  # solidity >= 0.8
      if a > a + b:
          revert with Panic(17)  # If an arithmetic operation results in underflow or overflow outside of an unchecked { ... } block.
      return a + b
  def sub(a, b):  # solidity >= 0.8
      if a - b > a:
          revert with Panic(17)  # If an arithmetic operation results in underflow or overflow outside of an unchecked { ... } block.
      return a - b

def getOrderStatus(bytes32 orderHash): # not payable
  require calldata.size - 4 >=′ 32
  return bool(uint8(orderStatus[orderHash].field_0)), 
         bool(uint8(orderStatus[orderHash].field_8)),
         uint120(orderStatus[orderHash].field_16),
         orderStatus[orderHash].field_136

def getContractOffererNonce(address contractOfferer): # not payable
  require calldata.size - 4 >=′ 32
  require not Mask(96, 160, contractOfferer)
  return contractOffererNonce[contractOfferer]

def getCounter(address offerer): # not payable
  require calldata.size - 4 >=′ 32
  require not Mask(96, 160, offerer)
  return counter[offerer]

def _fallback(?) payable: # default function
  require not calldata.size
  if stor0 != 3:
      revert with InvalidMsgValue(uint256 value), call.value

def incrementCounter(): # not payable
  require calldata.size - 4 >=′ 0
  if stor0 != 1:
      revert with NoReentrantCalls()
  _2 = counter[caller]

        uint256 newCounter=(block.hash(block.number - 1) >> 128) + _2,
        address indexed offerer=caller)
  return (block.hash(block.number - 1) >> 128) + _2

def fulfillBasicOrder((address,uint256,uint256,address,address,address,uint256,uint256,uint8,uint256,uint256,bytes32,uint256,bytes32,bytes32,uint256,(uint256,address)[],bytes) parameters) payable:

  require parameters <= 18446744073709551615

      revert with InvalidTime(uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime), cd[324], cd[356]
